How did the protest that began following Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation reach the call for “Jantar Mantar Reclaim”? This Delhi ground report by Nilanjay Tiwari explains the background of the protest, how it evolved, and what unfolded on the ground today.
In this Delhi Protest Ground Report, we cover the developments leading from the protest over Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation to the Jantar Mantar Reclaim demand. The report captures the atmosphere at the protest site, police deployment, barricading, detention of protesters, and key moments from today’s demonstration.
